title: Dependency Injection and Configuration
description: Understand how ASP.NET Core wires everything together: the Program.cs entry point, the middleware pipeline, appsettings.json configuration, and the built-in dependency injection container.
longDescription: This module covers the foundational infrastructure that every ASP.NET Core developer must understand. You will learn how Program.cs bootstraps the application, how middleware components process HTTP requests in order, how configuration is loaded from appsettings.json and environment-specific files, how to use the Options pattern for strongly typed settings, and how to register and consume services with the right lifetime (Transient, Scoped, or Singleton). By the end of the module you will be able to confidently configure any ASP.NET Core application and write clean, loosely coupled code using dependency injection.
whatYouLearn: Understand what Program.cs does and how the middleware pipeline processes HTTP requests
Read and override configuration values from appsettings.json
Apply dependency injection to achieve loosely coupled, testable code
Resolve dependency chains automatically with the built-in IoC container
Choose the correct service lifetime — Transient, Scoped, or Singleton — for each scenario
Use the Options pattern with IOptions<T>, IOptionsMonitor<T>, and IOptionsSnapshot<T>
Validate configuration at startup with IValidateOptions<T>
Configure multiple instances using named options
Inject services into Razor views with @inject and into action methods with [FromServices]
